abstract: A residue-three two-state transfer formula for predecessor multiplicity, exact rational counting series for distinct reachable cyclic high-density outputs, and exponential image-entropy gap.
integrity: Complete graph proof, formal power-series derivation, standalone standard-library checker; finite enumeration corroborates but does not replace the all-length proof.
limitations: Only Rule 22, one update, cyclic-00-avoiding outputs, and indexed fixed-period rings; no claim about general Rule-22 images, multistep reachability, or independent historical priority.
title: Period-three predecessor law and constrained image entropy for cyclic Rule 22
